data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP Crash as $1.7B Got Liquidated in 24 Hours
data.description: The crypto market just suffered its biggest flash crash since October 2025, wiping out $108 billion in just six minutes. The total market value fell from $2.68 trillion to $2.55 trillion as selling pressure increased. More than $1.71 billion in crypto positions were liquidated, hitting Bitcoin, Eth…
